scope: Previous COMPLETE measured cohorts only; latest sustained/interrupted/failed/recovery benchmark excluded from report, PR and commit, preserved locally. No new measurements.

units.throughput: DECIMAL MB/s = Mbit/s / 8 = delivered_bytes * 1000 / receiver_duration_ns; not MiB/s
units.latency: microseconds (us), nanoseconds /1000; original independent first-response ms converted *1000
units.loss: median of seven per-round directional loss percentages; actual aggregate lost counts retained separately
units.display_rounding: Three decimal places, Decimal(str(value)) ROUND_HALF_UP; exact numeric values retained.

estimators.throughput: Median of seven matched per-round rates, each direction separately.
estimators.established_rtt: Median of seven per-round medians, each round 256 established 64-byte application request/verified-response observations; 32 warmup echoes excluded. Not pooled.
estimators.fresh_first_response: Median of seven per-round medians, each round eight fresh application flows; proxy/WireGuard prewarmed, NOT cold WireGuard setup or SOCKS CONNECT.

Whole-product Git tree comparisons; not isolated causal GSO/batching effects.
